primary_evidence.gear_mounting: Single reduction helical gearbox for partly suspended drive, horizontal split housing; toothed motor coupling; direct on wheelset shaft
primary_evidence.source_observed_2026_11_08: Public manufacturer motor and drive pages confirm masses, self-ventilated air cooling and drive arrangement. No dimensioned housing or mounting drawing was found. Bounding boxes below are OSR hypotheses, not manufacturer dimensions.

coordinate_frame.axes: x forward along straight track, y left, z up from nominal rail head plane
coordinate_frame.bogie_origin: axle midpoint x/y, nominal rail head z=0

drive_envelopes.basis: Necessary-space hypotheses for retained public catalogue mass/rating only. Failed space and supplier compatibility gates cannot be promoted by changing this envelope silently. All definitions and evaluation identities change if these hypotheses change.

movement.basis: Explicit finite research domain, not a measured suspension travel or approved curve speed. Continuous conservative angular-displacement bounds supplement the finite pose list.

services.air_duct_design: Optional guarded flexible ventilation provision; self-ventilated catalogue motor has no demonstrated OSR hot-weather heat rejection. No unneeded hydraulic cooling loop is assumed.

cost_basis: Existing vehicle-installation low/base/high Chinese/bulk material-rate hypotheses and explicit gross stock, labour, weld, machining and QA quantities. Not supplier quotation; drive purchase cost and unknown drive BOP remain external and positive.
